description: This file defines the CronExpression class used for parsing, validating, and calculating next/previous run dates for CRON expressions within the Cron namespace. It includes methods for creating CRON expressions, setting parts, and determining if a CRON is due to run.

classes.name: CronExpression
classes.description: A parser and evaluator for CRON expressions, capable of determining next/previous run dates and if a CRON is due.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Creates a new CronExpression instance from predefined CRON shortcuts or custom expressions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CronExpression with a given CRON string and field factory.

methods.name: setExpression
methods.description: Sets or updates the CRON expression parts from a string.

methods.name: setPart
methods.description: Sets a specific part of the CRON expression after validating.

methods.name: getNextRunDate
methods.description: Returns the next scheduled run date after a given time.

methods.name: getPreviousRunDate
methods.description: Returns the previous scheduled run date before a given time.

methods.name: getMultipleRunDates
methods.description: Returns multiple run dates starting from a specific time.

methods.name: getExpression
methods.description: Retrieves the full or partial CRON expression string.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the full CRON expression as a string.

methods.name: isDue
methods.description: Checks if the CRON expression is due to run at the specified time.

methods.name: getRunDate
methods.description: Internal method to compute the next or previous run date based on parameters.
